## Notes

Raspberry Pi Pico W (RP2040, Cortex-M0+, 264 KiB SRAM) on Zephyr 3.7, serial only: zenoh over UART0, with the console on UART1, so the bench needs a USB-to-UART adapter. Hardware only: it is flashed by UF2 with `nros flash`, and no emulator twin runs it. The image needs `CONFIG_TICKLESS_KERNEL=n` (in the board's prj.conf) and five RAM knobs, which are the descriptor's `[knobs]` and every image inherits.

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
